style.summary: Rise sets Work Sans on night-black #17151A screens, with grouped #22222A rows rounded at 12 pt. Electric violet #7D05FC marks tabs, tags and add buttons, while orange marks energy numbers and the high end of the energy curve. Store shots frame each phone in a violet-to-orange sunrise over purple hills.

screenshots.alt: Become a morning person: App of the Day laurels, trusted by 5 million early risers, and Recommended by ESPN, Sleep Foundation and 4 more
Track the sleep you owe your body: My sleep for October 12-26, with 6.3 hrs of sleep debt and 77% energy potential
Check your energy level and optimize your day: an energy curve with Peak and Dip tags, Great 86%, and Avoid caffeine at 12:35
Sleep better with sleeping sounds and meditation: an 11m Reduce stress session, Sleeping sounds with a sleep timer, and a 2m breathing session
Build healthy habits: a Habits list with Workout, Avoid caffeine, Dinner, Blue-light glasses, Evening routine and Melatonin window
Use the calendar integration and plan your day: Morning grogginess, Morning peak and Afternoon dip blocks in the iOS Calendar for October 27, 2021
One widget to rule them all: home screen widgets for Evening peak, 31m until 21:21, and Wind-down until 9:40p with 7.5hrs sleep debt
Learn the science behind your sleep needs: Practical Science articles such as Lower Your Sleep Debt, Increase Overall Energy
Rise web paywall: a #february26 code for up to 40% off, a countdown, 3 plans priced per day with Quarterly picked at $0.32, then PayPal and card buttons
Rise quiz result: an ideal bedtime ring and “Your personalized energy & sleep plan is ready” under a discount countdown
Rise checkout: “Your personalized energy & sleep plan is ready”, PayPal and Link buttons, a card field, a purple Subscribe button and the renewal terms

trial.evidence: App Store description: “There’s also a limited-time free trial of 7 days to explore the premium features for free.”

ourRead: The same countdown, 09:45 in my capture, shows 3 times on the plan screen. The coupon reads #february26 in November, so the limited discount looks permanent.
Quarterly, the middle plan, is preselected as MOST POPULAR at $0.32 a day. Monthly wears a LITE VERSION tag; Semiannually is BEST PRICE at $0.27 a day.
The 40% covers the first period only. Checkout charges $29.99 for the intro period, then renews at $49.99, the crossed-out price.

improvements.title: Keep violet as the only accent
improvements.detail: Red, green and violet compete above the plans: a red #ED4443 banner, a green #95F3AB coupon card and the violet plan. The sticky bar already shows the timer, so drop the banner, grey the coupon and keep violet for the choice.
improvements.rule: One accent per screen. Directing attention means one place to look.

improvements.title: Show the ideal bedtime
improvements.detail: The plan screen blurs its one personal result, the ideal bedtime, above “Your personalized energy & sleep plan is ready”. Show the time, then sell the energy schedule behind it: the peaks and dips from the App Store screens.
improvements.rule: Onboarding before sign-up. Order: show the value, let them personalize, then ask them to sign up.

improvements.title: Put the renewal price on the card
improvements.detail: Quarterly leads with $0.32 a day, and the $49.99 renewal sits in 56 words of bullets under Subscribe. Print “$29.99 today, then $49.99 at renewal” on the Quarterly card, in one line.
improvements.rule: Cut verbose, redundant text. One sentence where AI wrote three.

stylePrompt:
Restyle my app in Rise's style. Keep my features, data and copy.
Colors:
- 60% night black #17151A: screens and sheets; rows and cards on #22222A.
- 30% electric violet #7D05FC: active tabs, tags and add buttons; violet text #8C58FC.
- 10% sunrise orange #C56B3D: energy numbers, peaks and session art.
Type:
- Headlines: Work Sans 700, about 21 pt, white over a grey Bold subline.
- Body: Work Sans 400, 13 to 17 pt; Work Sans 500 for row labels; secondary text #BCBCC0.
Shapes:
- Grouped lists 12 pt corners, cards 13 pt, sheet tops 28 pt; badges are full pills.
Layout:
- Lists inset 13 pt, 56 pt rows with 1 pt #323335 separators, 21 pt icon circles.
Components:
- Energy chart: a curve that fades from violet #6F1DFE (low) to orange #FC800C (high), with a white now line.
- Habit row: colored icon circle, label, bell and chevron on #22222A.
- Session card: 13 pt corners, orange gradient art #4C0210 to #DF7001, a white play disc, a #22222A footer row.
Icons and imagery:
- White line icons; violet-to-orange sunrise gradients behind heroes and onboarding.
Check:
- Every screen background is #17151A or #000000.
- Orange appears only on energy data and session art.
- Lists use 12 pt corners and 56 pt rows.
